name: Taskwarrior
author: Mhawar
description: Taskwarrior and Timewarrior time tracking in the Omarchy bar with Toggl-style 'What are you working on?' prompt, live timer, and task manager popup.

barWidget.description: Toggl-style active task timer and Taskwarrior task manager.

schema.label: Idle prompt text
schema.description: Message shown in the status bar when no task is currently active.

schema.label: Idle prompt color (red)
schema.description: Color used for the prompt and icon when not tracking.

schema.label: Idle reminder interval (minutes)
schema.description: Send a desktop notification every N minutes when idle.

schema.label: Auto-stop at Adhan
schema.description: Automatically stop active time tracking at prayer times (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha).
